ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Peck.cs:20-23) == cost 1 / ATTACK / EVENT / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(2m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new RepeatVar(3)` (Peck.cs:14-18) == both numbers, and `base_hits` reports 3.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(2).WithHitCount(Repeat.IntValue).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (Peck.cs:28-31) == a three-iteration loop of `DamageCmd.deal`. The sim's per-hit `if target.is_gone or ctx.player.is_dead: break` is the correct analogue of AttackCommand's `validTargets.Count == 0` and `Attacker.IsDead` breaks (AttackCommand.cs:540-550) for a single-target attack -- it skips further HITS rather than a separate effect, so it carries no CanReceivePowers finding.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Repeat.UpgradeValueBy(1m)` (Peck.cs:36) == `self._hits += 1` (3 -> 4). The DAMAGE stays 2 when upgraded -- the opposite of card/exterminate, whose upgrade raises the damage and leaves the repeat, and both were checked against their own sources.
